purpose: Test whether NSESche can retain the frozen FaaSRank throughput anchor while moving strictly toward the Hiku latency and Jiagu throughput frontier under paper-utility-improving coordination.

unchanged_components: FaaSRank faithful deterministic epsilon-greedy initializer and rolling diversity history
new_post_initializer_guard: candidate node must differ from the current node
candidate paper utility must exceed current utility by EPSILON
candidate frozen FaaSRank exploitation score must be nonworse within EPSILON
candidate outcome-blind Hiku/Jiagu ordinal-Borda penalty must be strictly lower by EPSILON
mechanism.hiku_expert: load-faithful Hiku penalty using only the current pre-placement state
mechanism.jiagu_expert: current-demand Jiagu penalty using only the current pre-placement state

execution_order: Commit this plan before changing the scheduler or generating E470-E499 inputs.
Implement exactly the three registered guards and unit-test their order, faithful initializer binding, and admissibility predicates.
Build one release binary and bind the same binary, Python, Cargo.lock, module config, workload tapes, common HPA and FaaSRank model to all twelve methods.
Capture E470-E479 base tapes once, derive scale5 once, and bind identical per-seed tapes to all twelve methods.
Build exactly thirty NSESche references, then run all ninety baselines and thirty candidates without reading intermediate performance.
Require 120 attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact twelve-way pairing and one runtime identity before a simultaneous reveal.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput/(drained-cohort mean latency*cost) across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.baseline_threshold: Per metric, the largest arithmetic mean among the nine same-seed baselines.
analysis.candidate_gate: A candidate must strictly exceed all three baseline thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.selection_rule: Among passing candidates, maximize the minimum relative margin across the three gates; an exact tie follows candidate list order.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-each-baseline paired BCa 95% intervals without changing the mean gate.
analysis.success_action: Freeze exactly one selected candidate and preregister all-nine-baseline E480-E499 confirmation before generating those inputs.
analysis.failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on E470-E479, and close this frontier-guard family.
